title: Antique Brass Modern Retractable Wall Hook, 2-1/2 Inch Pull-Out, Wall-Mounted Brass Hook, Allied Brass
description: Modern retractable wall hook with 2-1/2 inches / 2-1/2-inch / 2.5in pull-out hanging space for bathroom towels, robes, and coats in Antique Brass, which features a softened, aged golden patina that brings vintage charm and character to traditional spaces. This wall-mounted hook (wall mount hook) retracts back into the wall to save space and keep a crisp, minimalist look. Use as a towel hook, bathroom hook, wall hook, or retractable towel holder for modern bathroom hardware and contemporary bath accessories. Brass construction. The rod pulls out to provide 2-1/2'' of hanging space, then can be pushed back in so it's out of the way when not in use. Choose from 17 stylish finishes and four different models to match your decor. Gives you the option to remove the knob tip supplied with the item and replace it with a cabinet knob of your own, allowing you to match existing ones in the room! Can hold up to 15 pounds Fits standard interior walls Installation does require drilling a 3/4'' dia. hole through drywall and 3 small holes around 2 1/2'' of hanging space All mounting hardware included Specification & Documentation Product dimensions, in. (LxHxW): 2x2x3.75 Box dimensions, in. (LxHxW): 12x10x4 Shipping weight, lbs: 1.3 Installation Instruction Technical Specification MD-22-Installation.pdf MD-22-Specification.pdf

variants.title: Pink Modern Retractable Wall Hook, 2-1/2 Inch Pull-Out, Wall-Mounted Brass Hook, Allied Brass
variants.description: Modern retractable wall hook with 2-1/2 inches / 2-1/2-inch / 2.5in pull-out hanging space for bathroom towels, robes, and coats — available in Pink, which brings playful, modern energy to bathroom design, offering a fresh take on hardware that celebrates individuality. This wall-mounted hook (wall mount hook) retracts back into the wall to save space and keep a crisp, minimalist look. Use as a towel hook, bathroom hook, wall hook, or retractable towel holder for modern bathroom hardware and contemporary bath accessories. Brass construction. Fits standard interior walls; installs with included toggle bolts and mounting hardware. Installation requires drilling a 3/4 inch dia. hole through drywall plus 3 small holes. Holds up to 15 lb. Knob tip is removable so you can replace it with a cabinet knob of your choice. Overall size: 2 inches L x 2 inches H x 3.75 inches W. Backed by a lifetime warranty. Allied Brass.
